cards.definition: A small animal that says meow.
examples: My cat sleeps on my bed.
I brush my cat every week.
cards.situation: Tu présentes l’animal qui ronronne sur tes genoux.

cards.definition: An animal that says woof and likes people.
examples: Our dog waits by the door.
The dog plays with my friends.
cards.situation: Tu rentres chez toi et ton compagnon t’attend devant la porte.

cards.definition: An animal with wings and feathers.
examples: A bird sits outside my window.
We hear a bird every morning.
cards.situation: Tu regardes par la fenêtre et tu vois un animal à plumes posé dehors.

cards.definition: An animal that lives and swims in water.
examples: I see a fish in the tank.
Her fish swims in a bowl.
cards.situation: Tu observes un petit animal qui nage dans l’aquarium de ta chambre.

cards.definition: A slow animal with a hard shell on its back.
examples: The turtle walks very slowly.
My turtle eats fresh green leaves.
cards.situation: Tu observes un animal avancer lentement avec sa carapace sur le dos.

cards.definition: A large animal that people can ride.
examples: You can ride a horse here.
The horse runs across the field.
cards.situation: Tu arrives dans un centre équestre et tu montes sur un grand animal.

cards.definition: A small animal with long ears that eats plants.
examples: A rabbit eats carrots in the garden.
My rabbit sleeps in a small box.
cards.situation: Tu donnes une carotte à ton petit animal aux longues oreilles.

cards.definition: A large farm animal that gives milk.
examples: The cow gives milk every morning.
We see a cow near the road.
cards.situation: Tu visites une ferme et tu regardes l’animal qui produit le lait.

cards.definition: A farm animal with thick wool.
examples: A sheep lives on this farm.
The sheep eats grass all day.
cards.situation: Tu regardes un animal couvert de laine dans un champ.

cards.definition: A farm animal with horns that eats plants.
examples: The goat eats leaves near us.
I feed the goat after class.
cards.situation: Tu tends des feuilles à un animal avec deux cornes dans la ferme pédagogique.

cards.definition: A pink farm animal with a short nose.
examples: A pig lives on my uncle’s farm.
The pig is pink and fat.
cards.situation: Tu découvres dans la ferme un animal rose qui grogne et a un groin.

cards.definition: A bird that swims and says quack.
examples: The duck swims across the lake.
I watch the duck near the pond.
cards.situation: Tu regardes un oiseau aux pattes palmées glisser sur l’étang.

cards.definition: A farm bird that lays eggs.
examples: A chicken lays eggs every day.
The chicken walks across the yard.
cards.situation: Tu ramasses les œufs dans le poulailler après le passage de cet oiseau.

cards.definition: A very small animal with a long tail.
examples: A mouse runs under the kitchen table.
A mouse eats food in the barn.
cards.situation: Tu aperçois un tout petit animal gris filer sous le meuble de la cuisine.

cards.definition: A small flying insect that makes honey.
examples: A bee flies around the flowers.
A bee lands on my hand.
cards.situation: Tu vois un insecte jaune et noir venir butiner les fleurs du balcon.

cards.definition: A large wild animal with a mane.
examples: The lion lives in the zoo.
A lion has big teeth.
cards.situation: Tu observes au zoo un grand félin avec une épaisse crinière.

cards.definition: A very large animal with a long nose.
examples: An elephant drinks lots of water.
The elephant has very big ears.
cards.situation: Tu regardes au zoo un immense animal qui boit avec sa trompe.

cards.definition: An animal with a long tail that climbs trees.
examples: The monkey climbs up the tree.
A monkey eats a yellow banana.
cards.situation: Tu regardes au zoo un animal grimper aux branches en utilisant ses mains et sa queue.

cards.definition: A long animal with no legs.
examples: A snake moves through the grass.
The snake hides under a rock.
cards.situation: Tu aperçois un animal long et sans pattes qui se déplace dans l’herbe.

cards.definition: A sea animal that swims and jumps.
examples: A dolphin jumps out of the sea.
The dolphin swims beside our boat.
cards.situation: Tu regardes depuis le bateau un mammifère marin bondir hors de l’eau.
